panels.title: Current AIF Mode
panels.description: Runtime mode at the selected range end. Observe provides hypothetical cache savings only; guards may still enforce policy. Multiple active modes may be shown.

panels.title: Chat Cost
panels.description: Estimated chat provider cost; excludes embedding overhead.

panels.title: Gross Savings
panels.description: Actual production savings only; a missing lazy series is shown as zero when request history and runtime telemetry exist. Evaluation savings are excluded.

panels.title: Embedding Cost
panels.description: Embedding overhead cost, including applicable lookup and store operations.

panels.title: Net Savings
panels.description: Actual production savings only; a missing lazy series is shown as zero when request history and runtime telemetry exist. Evaluation savings are excluded.

targets.expr: 100 * (sum(increase(aif_net_saved_micro_usd_total[$__range])) or on() (0 * sum(increase(aif_requests_total[$__range])) and on() (max(aif_enforcement_mode_info) == 1))) / ((sum(increase(aif_model_cost_micro_usd_total[$__range])) + (sum(increase(aif_net_saved_micro_usd_total[$__range])) or on() (0 * sum(increase(aif_requests_total[$__range])) and on() (max(aif_enforcement_mode_info) == 1)))) > 0)

panels.title: Net Savings %
panels.description: Actual net savings divided by estimated chat spend plus actual net savings. No percentage without a positive denominator.

targets.expr: (100 * (sum(increase(aif_cache_hits_total[$__range])) or on() (0 * sum(increase(aif_requests_total[$__range])) and on() (max(aif_enforcement_mode_info) == 1))) / (((sum(increase(aif_cache_hits_total[$__range])) or on() (0 * sum(increase(aif_requests_total[$__range])) and on() (max(aif_enforcement_mode_info) == 1))) + (sum(increase(aif_cache_misses[$__range])) or on() (0 * sum(increase(aif_requests_total[$__range])) and on() (max(aif_enforcement_mode_info) == 1)))) > 0)) or on() ((0 * sum(increase(aif_requests_total[$__range])) and on() (max(aif_enforcement_mode_info) == 1)) and on() (max(aif_enforcement_mode_info{mode="observe"}) == 1) unless on() (max(aif_enforcement_mode_info{mode="enforce"}) == 1))

panels.title: Cache Hit Rate
panels.description: Actual hits / (hits + misses). Zero in Observe when there are no production lookups; historical production lookups remain visible. N/A when no production lookup denominator exists in Enforce.

title: AI Cost Firewall Overview
description: Overview dashboard for AI Cost Firewall: estimated chat cost, gross savings, embedding overhead, net savings, per-model spend, per-cache-type savings, request-level cost indicators, cache bypass activity, Usage Guard policy stops, and high-level guard orchestration health. Intentional Security/Usage policy decisions are control outcomes and are not treated as operational errors, with high-level streaming request and failure/abort visibility.
